en: Black‑and‑white street view of a European city. On the left corner stands an ornate late‑19th‑century building with signs identifying it as "Hotel Klosterhof" with a restaurant, operated by Heinrich Sandmann. Across a cobblestone square in the background is a grand historicist building with a central tower, decorative gables, and spires, likely a town hall or similar civic building. Street lamps and a tree‑lined avenue extend to the right; a few pedestrians are visible, dressed in early‑20th‑century clothing.
